name: acf-whip
description: The ACF cycle, out of the box: /whip says where you are and the one command to run next; risky work gets a plan in docs/cycles/ approved once and bound to its content hash, /task --plan decomposes it, /go builds it, /whip shows coverage, /retro records lessons. Workflow-native backlog automation with per-task authored child workflows. /task decomposes a scope into atomic, dependency-aware tasks; /go runs each unit as its OWN nested multi-agent workflow — a harness a workflow-architect agent fills into a locked, validated skeleton — in isolated git worktrees (one per slug), then reviews and integrates via LP-CAS, looping until every task is accepted or blocked. A bare /go runs your FOCUS: the tasks /task just created, or the ones you selected with /whip-focus — so the ordinary path needs no arguments and still runs only your own work, while /go --all drains the whole backlog and /go <ids|MUL-1234|a natural-language filter> runs exactly what you name. On a shared board a bare /go with no focus refuses rather than draining everyone's queue. The snapshot is narrowed in the STORE (--only emits just the closure of the named tasks) and carries a relay header the orchestrator verifies, so a large board can no longer be silently truncated on its way through a scan agent and reported back as missing task ids. An integrity FATAL now holds out the ONE task it names instead of stopping the run, so a single malformed card cannot block a whole team; runs that hold something out report partial, never complete. Pausing is a real state on every backend (/whip-move <task> draft, archive to cancel), and doctor --fix never overwrites a hold a human set. Agents route by tier — cheap for the fixed-command shell runners, the project's declared per-agent model for specialists and reviewers — and every run reports which tier spent what. Task state lives behind an executable adapter contract: .backlog/ files (default), beads, multica, or Linear. Integration is a compare-and-swap of a single-parent candidate onto the live trunk with an in-tree ledger marker as the sole oracle. Concurrency-safe and self-healing via /whip-doctor.
